title: Hypothesis failure for Ioana's Theorem 8.2 under a twisted comultiplication (v0.1.2-report)
description: Bounded public report (v0.1.2). Short note PDF + long-form package: Ioana Theorem 8.2 does not apply to the twisted comultiplication Θ because hypothesis (2) fails by construction. Primary file: nielsen-ioana-theta-reductio-arxiv.pdf. Companion Lean DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21859309. Version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21859653; concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21845586.
